# v2.0 sanity check

*Generated by `python -m pipeline.build`. These comparisons check plausibility; they are not a calibration (PRD 0A.2). Every skyglow output stays labeled "uncalibrated planning projection".*

## Corpus site values (Clear Dark Sky / IDA figures, PRD 6.5)

One global flux scale (alpha = 0.460) is fitted to these ten values; RMSE 0.46 mag.
Coordinates are the approximate PRD 6.5 values (open item: verify).

## Globe at Night (not used in any fit)

186 clear-sky observations inside the Module A grid (53 with an SQM reading) from 20 yearly files.

- **SQM readings** (instrumented, the meaningful comparison): median residual (model - observed) +0.52 mag, median absolute deviation 0.45 mag; 11 readings taken 00:00-05:00 have median residual +0.21 mag.
- **All observations** including naked-eye limiting magnitudes: median residual +2.13 mag, median absolute deviation 1.50 mag.

A positive residual means the model is darker than the observation. Evening naked-eye estimates are coarse (one-magnitude chart steps map to 0.5-1.5 mag/arcsec²) and taken before curfews, so a positive bias is expected.
